sources.title: levossadtchi/QED-75M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: QED-75M is a compact decoder-only causal language model implemented for Hugging Face using a custom transformers module. The model architecture combines RoPE (rotary position embeddings), RMSNorm, SwiGLU feed-forward blocks, and causal self-attention implemented via torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.
